help.accountLinkingGuideDesc: 关联交易所账户、API权限和管理已关联账户的综合指南
help.faqB1A: Roua是一个智能交易账户关联和追踪平台，通过安全的API密钥连接您在不同交易所（如Binance和Alpaca）的账户，监控和分析您的投资组合表现。该平台不直接执行交易，而是追踪您关联的账户，使用Gemini、Groq和GLM-4等多个AI模型提供全面的AI驱动分析。平台提供高级分析洞察、智能信号、风险分析和账户活动即时警报 — 所有功能都在易于使用的界面中。
help.faqB2A: 您可以在几分钟内创建免费账户，只需访问注册页面并输入您的邮箱和强密码。注册后，您将收到确认邮件以激活账户。您也可以使用Google账户快速注册。激活后，您可以通过API密钥关联Binance或Alpaca等首选交易所，立即开始追踪和分析您的投资组合。
help.faqB3A: 我们提供四种订阅方案：免费版可有限访问基本工具并关联一个交易所账户的演示模式；专业版可关联最多3个交易所账户，提供智能信号和高级分析；高级版增加高级AI功能，可关联最多10个账户并提供账户表现追踪；机构版为专业人士提供无限账户和所有功能的完整访问。每种方案在关联账户数量、每日信号、可用AI模型和分析级别方面有所不同。
help.faqB4A: 当然可以！您可以在不关联任何交易所的情况下通过演示模式使用Roua。该模式让您可以使用虚拟市场数据尝试所有分析和AI工具，帮助您在关联真实账户前学习平台和探索其功能。准备好后，您可以通过设置页面轻松关联交易所，同时保持最高的安全标准。
help.faqT1A: 要关联新的交易所账户，前往设置页面并选择「已关联账户」部分。点击「关联新账户」并选择您要关联的交易所（如Binance或Alpaca）。您需要从交易所账户创建一个只有读取和交易权限的API密钥 — 确保未启用提现权限。在平台中输入API密钥和密钥，连接将自动验证。关联成功后，平台将立即开始追踪您的余额和持仓。
help.faqT2A: 关联账户后，平台提供一个综合追踪仪表盘，在一处显示您所有关联的账户。您可以查看所有交易所的总余额、盈亏、持仓和投资组合分布。可以使用交互式图表追踪不同时间段（每日、每周、每月）的投资组合表现。您还可以比较不同交易所关联账户的表现，并直观分析您的资产分布。
help.faqT3A: 关联账户只需读取权限以监控您的余额和持仓。交易/现货交易权限是可选的，仅在您启用关联账户的自动执行信号功能时使用。最重要的是，我们绝不会要求提现权限 — 系统会自动拒绝包含此权限的密钥。我们建议创建一个专用于Roua的API密钥，权限尽可能最小，如果交易所支持，还可以将密钥限制为我们的IP地址。
help.faqT4A: 平台提供您可以完全自定义的综合智能警报系统。您可以设置价格变动、余额变化、开仓或平仓以及达到特定盈亏目标的警报。警报通过多个渠道提供：平台内通知、邮件和浏览器警报。您还可以启用AI警报，在关联账户上检测到异常市场模式或潜在交易机会时通知您。警报管理可在设置页面的「通知」部分找到。
help.faqA1Q: How does the AI委员会 work?
help.faqA1A: AI委员会是一项独特功能，结合了来自Gemini、Groq、GLM-4、HuggingFace、Ollama和Bedrock等多个独立AI模型的分析。每个模型独立分析金融资产，提供其推荐（买入、卖出、持有）以及置信水平和理由。然后平台根据每个模型的置信度权重计算共识推荐。这种多模型方法减少了任何单一模型的偏差，与依赖单一模型相比显著提高了推荐准确性。
help.faqA2Q: What are Smart 信号 and how do I use them?
help.faqA2A: 智能信号是基于综合AI分析的交易推荐，结合了技术指标（RSI、EMA、MACD）、市场情绪分析和价格模式。每个信号包括交易方向（买入/卖出）、置信水平、建议入场点、止损和目标。您可以启用即时通知以立即接收信号，或在信号页面上查看。高置信度信号（80%以上）标有特殊徽章，如果您有交易权限，可以一键直接执行。
help.faqA3A: 是, you can enable automatic signal execution from the AI settings page if you're subscribed to a PRO plan or higher and have enabled trading permission in your API key. This allows you to set specific rules such as minimum confidence level for auto-executing trades, maximum position size, and daily loss limit. 导入antly, trades are executed through your linked exchange account directly — the platform never holds your funds — we only link your accounts and do not act as a financial intermediary. We strongly recommend monitoring AI recommendations first to understand their style before enabling auto-execution.
help.faqS1A: We take API key security extremely seriously. 全部 keys are encrypted using AES-256-GCM, one of the strongest encryption algorithms globally approved. Keys are stored encrypted in an isolated database and can only be accessed through trusted execution services. We automatically reject any key that has Withdraw permissions to ensure no party can withdraw your funds. Additionally, all key access operations are audited and logged in monitored security logs.
help.faqS2A: 否, never! Roua does not have or request withdrawal permissions from your exchange account. We only use API keys with limited read and trade permissions, and never accept keys that include withdrawal or transfer permissions. This means your funds remain safe in your exchange account and cannot be withdrawn by anyone else even if your Roua account is compromised. We always recommend creating API keys dedicated to Roua only with the minimum possible permissions.
help.faqS3A: We provide multiple layers of protection for your account: First, two-factor authentication (2FA) via authenticator app or SMS that adds an extra security layer at login. 秒, a suspicious login detection system that alerts you when access is attempted from a new device or location. Third, you can monitor and manage your active sessions and terminate any suspicious session immediately. Fourth, comprehensive encryption of sensitive data and periodic session identity verification every 15 minutes. We recommend using a unique, strong password and enabling 2FA immediately.
help.faqS4A: We adhere to the highest privacy and data protection standards. Your personal data is encrypted and not shared with any third party without your explicit consent. We use aggregated, non-identifiable trading data only to improve our AI models' performance, and never link it to your personal account. You can export all your data at any time from the settings page, and you can request complete deletion of your data. We undergo regular security re次浏览 and comply with international data protection regulations to ensure your information's safety.
help.faqP1A: You can easily upgrade your plan from the settings page under the subscription section. Choose the new plan and the price difference will be calculated proportionally based on the remaining duration of your current subscription. Upgrades take effect immediately and you get all new features right away. 降级s take effect at the end of the current billing cycle to ensure you benefit fully from the paid period. We accept payment via credit and debit cards, bank transfers, and major cryptocurrencies.
help.faqP2A: 是, you can cancel your subscription at any time without any additional fees or penalties. Upon cancellation, your account remains active with current plan features until the end of the paid subscription period. After the period ends, your account is automatically converted to the free plan while retaining all your data and account tracking history. You can reactivate your subscription at any time in the future and regain all your previous features. We do not charge any hidden fees or auto-renew without your prior consent.
help.chatDesc: 实时 chat is available for 专业版 plan subscribers and above during working hours from Sunday to Thursday, 9 AM to 9 PM Saudi time. For other plans, you can leave a message and we'll respond as soon as possible.
